key_correction.statement: The two 40,000,000 XRP transfers reported by Whale Alert at 03:55:31 and 03:56:21 UTC on November 2 are part of the original attacker's redistribution from the original attacker account into the six recipient wallets. They are not evidence of a later 80M XRP outflow from those six recipient wallets.
key_correction.interpretation: The 80M figure is a subset of the nine large payments in the 03:52–04:00 UTC redistribution. It must not be added to the 233.46M stolen amount or described as a separate subsequent sale/movement.

event_timeline.event: Five Binance-attributed XRPL hot wallets transferred a reported total of 233,461,943.1 XRP to the original attacker account.
Q-Eternal reports a 1,000 XRP test payment from the original attacker account to a separate seventh test address.
Q-Eternal reports six 1,000 XRP test payments to the six eventual main recipient accounts.
The original attacker account sent nine large payments distributing the main XRP balance to six newly created accounts.
Whale Alert reported a 40M XRP payment from the original attacker account to one of the new recipient wallets; the exact first-transfer hash was not retrieved in this run.
Whale Alert transaction page identifies a validated 40M XRP payment from the original attacker account to rhXtRtpfZRAKVayWd5Z5kRJ2YXYkcuxNRD; fee 0.00001 XRP.
Bitquery's chain read reports seven new XRPL accounts held the full approximately 233.5M XRP distribution and none had sent anything onward by that cutoff.
Q-Eternal reports ledger 108064685 showed the seven new destination accounts had only received XRP and had zero outgoing transactions; exact ledger close time was not supplied.
A separate 50M XRP transfer from a Binance-labeled wallet to an unidentified address was reported. No available transaction trail links it to the attacker account.

reconciliation.discrepancy_note: The combined reported balance is 0.59905 XRP above the TRM/XRPLWin initial theft total. Do not attribute the difference to fees, rounding, or a particular transaction until all validated transactions and delivered_amount fields are replayed.

recipient_status.freshness_warning: No live account_tx query was executed in this run. The 13:26 UTC Bitquery observation and later Q-Eternal ledger-index report are pinned historical snapshots, not proof of status at the artifact creation time.

separate_binance_wallet_observation.interpretation: A tagged-address balance change is not proof of customer net withdrawals, sale, or theft. It may reflect custody reorganization, customer withdrawals, rebalancing, or other transfers. The separately reported 50M Binance-labeled transfer on November 1 is a candidate match, but transaction-level identity has not been established.

market_observations.note: Approximate mark from contemporaneous reporting, not a synchronized consolidated quote. Do not use as an exact transaction valuation.

source_records.observation: Reports 233.46M XRP taken from five Binance-attributed XRPL hot wallets; describes wider incident and stablecoin freezes.

Reports seven new XRPL accounts held approximately 233.5M XRP and none had sent onward by 13:26 UTC on November 2; provides transaction/account methodology and explicitly warns address labels may be incomplete.

Reports six recipient wallets, one separate test wallet, ledger 108064685, no outgoing from the seven new accounts, and balances across 160 Binance-labelled accounts. Exact ledger close time is not supplied.
40M XRP transfer at 03:56:21 UTC from the original attacker account to rhXtRtpfZRAKVayWd5Z5kRJ2YXYkcuxNRD; hash and fee displayed.

Reports two 40M XRP transfers 50 seconds apart from the attacker account and a separate 50M transfer from a Binance-labelled wallet on November 1; explicitly says the 50M transfer is not linked to the attacker.
